name: Lawn aeration and overseeding
summary: Core aeration and overseeding priced from turf area, aerator passes, seed and starter fertilizer.

items.label: Core aerate turf, 2 passes
items.source: Turf = 12,000 lot - 2,500 beds (index.html); aerator 2 ft swath x 2.5 mph x 5280 x 60% = 15,840 sq ft/h, 2 passes (index.html, formula in calc.mjs); material is machine cost: (rental $18/h + 0.8 gal/h x $3.70 fuel) per aerator hour

items.label: Overseed with starter fertilizer
items.source: Seeding speed 25,000 sq ft/h; seed 6 lb/1,000 sq ft at $2.80/lb + fertilizer 3 lb/1,000 sq ft at $1.10/lb (index.html defaults)

items.label: Flagging, gates, cleanup, load and unload
items.source: Extra on-site hours 0.5 + load/unload hours 0.5 per person; other supplies $6/job (index.html defaults). Drive hours (0.5) and truck cost left to the suite's mileage on 30 round-trip miles

items.label: Share of yearly overhead
items.source: Yearly insurance/truck/overhead $4,800 / 120 jobs per season (index.html defaults); the specialist allocates overhead per job, not as a % of direct cost

specialistModels: Minimum job fee, card fees on revenue, per-job share of yearly overhead, tax set-aside, break-even jobs per season and a two-job comparison.
